message: uv reads settings only from the workspace root, so exclude-newer in packages/api/pyproject.toml has no effect
fix: Set exclude-newer in the root uv.toml or [tool.uv] of the root pyproject.toml, and remove it from packages/api/pyproject.toml

message: uv reads settings only from the workspace root, so no-build in packages/core/uv.toml has no effect
fix: Set no-build in the root uv.toml or [tool.uv] of the root pyproject.toml, and remove it from packages/core/uv.toml
